title: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker, Jace's beloved, who lives grieving with his mother on Vryn and agrees to go help reach him.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Jace's mother, a healer, who lost her son twice and gives Vraska a wrapped package for him.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A small, excitable, telepathic creature with little horns who lives with Vraska and Ranna and draws maps.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who tells Vraska Jace is alive and recruits Garruk.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker traveling with Chandra to gather help against Jace.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A huge planeswalker druid and hunter living in a lodge on Muraganda, who can smell through Jace's illusions and agrees to help for information about containment.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: A fragmented, clinical version of Jace who stores the Multiverse map in Theorix cadets and storms away from the Guildpact.

entities.name: Guildpact Jace
entities.description: The honest, wise piece of Jace imprisoned in the ruins of the Chamber of the Guildpact, who tells the Theorist he is in over his head.

entities.name: General Beleren
entities.description: A dream version of Jace as a face-tattooed warlord who did kill Alhammarret and tells Vraska 'I can be both'.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind-mage who survived and is feared to still be pursuing his plan.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A figure whose skull sits before General Beleren.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon whose imprisonment happened in the Chamber of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A hero whose sacrifice was mourned in the Chamber of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Zimone
entities.description: Someone who gave Chandra and Ajani a destination.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane where Vraska stays with Ranna.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A jungle plane where Garruk lives.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where Jace's imaginary sanctum and the Chamber of the Guildpact are seen.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A plane Vraska and Jace considered bringing Garruk to.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: A ruined chamber in a memory-prison where the Guildpact is held.

entities.name: Garruk's Lodge
entities.description: A cozy round wooden lodge in the Muraganda jungle with a tripwire field.

entities.name: The Meditation Realm
entities.description: The realm where Jace was lost and may have put himself back together.

entities.name: Theorix
entities.description: The Hexhaven school whose cadets the Theorist uses to store the map.

entities.name: The Golgari
entities.description: The Ravnican guild Vraska once ruled.

events.summary: Vraska lives with Ranna and Loot on Vryn, mourning Jace and wracked by guilt for turning away from him.
events.quote: Mostly what plagues her is guilt. She turned away from him.

events.summary: Chandra and Ajani arrive at the flat and tell them that Jace is alive.
events.quote: "Jace is alive," Chandra says, and in three words, Vraska's entire world falls apart.

events.summary: Chandra and Ajani explain that a gorgon working for Jace kidnapped an oracle, and Vraska deduces he needs knowledge of how planes fuse.
events.quote: "There was knowledge he did not possess, specifically about the fusion of planes."

events.summary: Vraska agrees to help reach Jace, and Ranna entrusts her with a wrapped package for him.
Loot draws maps for Vraska, and she sends Chandra and Ajani to recruit Garruk on Muraganda.
events.quote: If we want a chance at making our way to Jace, then we'll need Garruk's help.

events.summary: Chandra and Ajani find Garruk's lodge on Muraganda, guarded by tripwires, and he leads them in.
events.quote: This tower of muscles can only be Garruk Wildspeaker.

events.summary: Chandra explains that Jace's plan would overwrite the Multiverse, and Garruk says illusions don't smell real to him.
Garruk agrees to help in exchange for information about wards, seals and magical containment.
events.quote: "I need people who understand wards, seals, magical containment.

events.summary: The Theorist visits the Guildpact for counsel and has him check his proofs, which show the overlay is collapsing.
The Theorist reveals that he stores the Multiverse map in the Theorix cadets.
The Guildpact calls the Theorist a machine that can't even kill one oracle and warns he intends to overwrite their home; the Theorist puts him to sleep.
events.quote: The Theorist flicks a hand, and the Guildpact collapses to the rubble with a sick thud, dead asleep.

events.summary: Vraska, traveling to Strixhaven by Omenpath, camps in a swamp and dreams of General Beleren.
events.quote: She is in the center of an alder-lined war room.

events.summary: In the dream, General Beleren says he is the part that frightens her, kisses her cheek and says he can be both a good man and a monster.
events.quote: His lips graze her cheek. "I can be both ."

events.summary: Vraska wakes and realizes Jace is both good and monstrous, and that she may have made a mistake.
events.quote: He is both , she realizes with mournful shame, with defiant fierceness.

relations.quote: She meets Ranna's eyes (his eyes). His mother doesn't smile.

relations.note: Vraska loves Jace and calls him her beloved.
relations.quote: She hopes to dream of Jace, the old Jace, her beloved.

relations.note: The Guildpact hates the Theorist and argues with him.
Garruk agrees to help in return for information.
Ranna plays with and watches over Loot.
